exceptions.justification: normaliseEmail (src/core/identifier.ts) builds `http://<domain>` only to hand an email domain to the WHATWG URL parser, which converts it to its IDNA A-label form (ADR 0021 Open 3). No request is ever made to it. Approved by the owner (MaverickCER) on 2026-11-16.
exceptions.alternatives: node:url domainToASCII (refused: the core imports no node: module, ADR 0003 §7); a bundled IDNA table (refused: a large dependency for one conversion).
exceptions.attempted: Removing the scheme: the URL parser needs a special scheme to apply host parsing and IDNA.
exceptions.constraint: Standard globals only (ADR 0003 §7), and URL is the only standard IDNA converter.
exceptions.remediation: None needed: the string is a parser input, never fetched.
exceptions.residualRisk: Socket.dev may still flag the template; a reviewer reads this record.
exceptions.revisitWhen: A standard global for IDNA conversion appears, or identifier normalisation moves out of the core.
exceptions.ruleBroken: A URL appears in the published bundle.
exceptions.whyPreferable: One standard parser and no dependency, for a value that never leaves the process.

exceptions.justification: The HIBP breached-password range check (ADR 0010 §2 to §4) calls this host. Only the first five hex characters of the password's SHA-1 leave the process, with Add-Padding, through the fetch the app hands createAuth. Approved by the owner (MaverickCER) on 2026-11-16.
exceptions.alternatives: Bundling a breach corpus (refused: hundreds of megabytes and stale at once); letting the app supply the URL (refused: a URL from configuration is an SSRF surface, ADR 0026 §5).
exceptions.attempted: Keeping it out of the bundle is not possible: the check is the feature.
exceptions.constraint: ADR 0010 makes breach screening a default.
exceptions.remediation: None needed: the host is fixed in source and the fetch is the app's.
exceptions.residualRisk: An app that turns the screen off still ships the string; it is never fetched then.
exceptions.ruleBroken: A URL appears in the published bundle.
exceptions.whyPreferable: A fixed, documented host is easier to review than one read from configuration.
